findings.subject: Execution and failure semantics
findings.finding: The sole execv remains in its original try block and invokes the fixed driver under /usr/bin/python3 -B. Successful exec replaces the bootstrap process; its future driver exit is not converted by the bootstrap into success. If bootstrap work or execv itself raises after mkdir, the unchanged handler attempts a new BOOTSTRAP_FAILURE.json, preserves partial records, and re-raises. Before creation it cannot retain that local failure file. A failure of the best-effort failure recorder is swallowed only before the original error is re-raised. There is no unlink, overwrite, rollback or retry path.
